This beautifully produced doc takes a provocative look at the events leading up to the global financial crisis, revealing how the attempt to avoid a ruinous collapse of banks may have set the world on the path to an even bigger meltdown.

overview.de: „Pam & Tommy" spielt in den frühen Wildwest-Tagen des Internets und basiert auf der unglaublichen wahren Geschichte des Sex-Tapes von Pamela Anderson (Lily James) und Tommy Lee (Sebastian Stan). Das Video, das von einem verärgerten Handwerker (Seth Rogen) aus dem Haus des Paares gestohlen wurde, entwickelte sich von einer raubkopierten VHS-Kuriosität zu einer weltweiten Sensation, als es 1997 i...
overview.en: Set in the Wild West early days of the Internet, PAM & TOMMY is based on the incredible true story of Anderson (LILY JAMES) and Tommy Lee (SEBASTIAN STAN) sex tape.
Ryan Swan must carve his way through the Hawaiian crime world to wreak vengeance on a kingpin.

Politics are no laughing matter, but in this satire, the entire European Parliament is a joke. New assistant Samy fumbles his way through reports and amendments, his boss literally runs away from work, and grown officials throw ragers over Brexit.

Partners in Crime is an espionage adventure series about a suburban married couple, Tommy and Tuppence Beresford, who solve mysteries and foil plots in '50s Cold War Britain. Based on Agatha Christie's classic characters, Tommy (David Walliams) and Tuppence (Jessica Raine) may approach their cases in a somewhat haphazard manner.

title.de: Paul - Ein Alien auf der Flucht

overview.de: So haben sich die begeisterten Science-Ficiton-Fans Graeme (Simon Pegg) und Clive (Nick Frost) ihren Erstkontakt mit einem Alien nicht vorgestellt: Auf ihrer Pilgerfahrt zur legendären Area 51 steht plötzlich der kleine grüne Klugscheißer Paul vor ihnen. Er wird vom FBI gejagt und will möglichst schnell zu seinem Mutterschiff zurück. Natürlich helfen die beiden UFO-Freaks dem flüchtigen Außerirdischen, der ihr Universum für immer verändert und sie vielleicht sogar zu intergalaktischen Helden macht.
overview.en: During a road trip to visit famous UFO sites, two sci-fi geeks encounter a wisecracking alien named Paul who is on the run from federal agents.

overview.de: Bei ihren Abenteuern stellen sich der junge Halbgott Percy Jackson und seine Freund*innen Monstern, mächtigen Gegner*innen und Bedrohungen, die den Olymp gefährden.
overview.en: Percy Jackson takes on the Titan’s curse to save Annabeth and Olympus.

Inspired by a 1970s Russian science experiment on fox domestication, Joakim embarks on the art of selective breeding and training, realising his childhood dream of owning his own pack of foxes. However, his pet project abruptly halts when local authorities declare the farm a violation of wildlife law, threatening to euthanize his foxes. To what extent will Joakim go to protect what he holds dear?
A sci-fi anthology series with stand-alone episodes based on the works of Philip K. Dick.

title.de: Pietje Bell und das Geheimnis der schwarzen Hand

overview.en: When a loveable scamp's pranks become plentiful, they are published in the local newspaper; the stories tell of Peter's adventures and antics in the hope it will keep the newspaper afloat.
Look out Night Time Baddies the PJ Masks are coming!
Elfuda traveled to our world through a portal from another dimension… but then she gained weight and couldn’t return home. Can Naoe-kun help this loveable elf girl, lose the weight—and keep it off?
A young singer/songwriter, despite being married, becomes involved with her new guitarist, who she soon discovers has a dark past and may be a danger to her and those close to her.

Join Pocoyó, the curious little boy dressed all in blue, as he embarks on exciting adventures with his friends - Pato, Elly, Loula, and Sleepy Bird. Together, they explore their infinite world, tackle challenges, and discover the joy of friendship.

As our story inches closer to the finale, God's endgame for the universe begins to click into place. Trapped between heavenly prophecies, hellish prisons, and all-out nuclear war, Jesse, Tulip, and Cassidy make their bloody way to the Most High. Whether they can reach God in time — or whether all this carnage is part of His divine plan — will soon be revealed as Preacher barrels towards the end..

Veteran bear trainer Jeff Watson takes on perhaps his toughest task in more than 25 years of rescuing and raising the majestic animals. His goal - to reverse the cycle of man's ownership over animals - involves 700-pound grizzlies Bob and Screech, whom he has raised since they were 6 weeks old. Now, after three years, Jeff believes their destiny is to live in the wild, and `Project Grizzly' tracks the trainer's emotional struggle to undo all he has taught the bears in captivity. At a remote Indiana location, Bob and Screech must learn how to hunt, fish and hibernate, and ultimately break their dependence on a human. Unforeseen hurdles lead to some doubt, but Jeff is determined to complete this incredible, dangerous challenge.

After a disastrous first date, wild-child Nicole and socially-anxious Max vow to lose each other’s numbers until they learn that their dogs found a love match, and now puppies are on the way! The hilariously mismatched Nicole and Max are forced to become responsible co-parents, but may end up finding love themselves. Starring Lucy Hale and Grant Gustin.
Bosnia, 1995. When the Serbian army takes over her town, a UN translator becomes a conduit for crucial negotiations as her community seeks shelter.

overview.de: Als ihre Schwester heiratet, kehrt ein ehemaliges Model, das mehrere Entzugskuren hinter sich hat, zurück nach Hause, wo langjährige Familienkonflikte wieder aufflammen.
overview.en: Rachel Getting Married is a contemporary drama with an aggressive sense of humor about the return of an estranged daughter to the family home for her sister's wedding. Kym's (Hathaway) reemergence throws a wrench into the family dynamics, forcing long-simmering tensions to surface in ways both hilarious and heartbreaking. Rachel Getting Married paints a colorful, nuanced family portrait and is ..

Nand is amongst the rush of men who pursue Shanu, the new English teacher in Meerut. Upon his discovering her supposed alter-ego, the sex-obsessed spirit of Rasbhari, their relationship takes a new turn. A now matured Nand, takes up the responsibility of saving Shanu from the ongoing witch hunt by the women of the town initiated by his own mother, Pushpa.

overview.de: Im Jahr 2045, der Virtual-Reality-Welt, ist die OASIS die Zukunft. Begleiten Sie Wade & seine Freunde auf der digitalen Schatzsuche durch ein Universum voller Geheimnisse und Gefahren.
overview.en: Steven Spielberg's futuristic tale in which the late creator of a virtual universe leaves it to anyone who can find an Easter Egg.

Rebellion is the first feature-length documentary to tell the behind the scenes story of Extinction Rebellion from its launch in 2018. With unprecedented access, the film follows a group of unlikely allies and captures the human drama of social movements first hand.
A legendary blind psychic comes out of his 30-year retirement to face his once-fearless adversary in a ghost whisper-debunking paranormal researcher.

With racism, homophobia and mental health issues all on the rise in football, Rio is done talking about things and tokenistic campaigning and wants to create real change. Rooted in a personal drive to understand, unpack and tackle the problems, Rio wants to meet people from across the game to change the landscape for future generations.

overview.de: Knallharter und brutaler Gangsterfilm mit Vinnie Jones (Snatch) und Keith Allen (Kingsman), nach wahren Begebenheiten. Die Nummer 1 in UK. Aufstieg und Fall des Kriegsveteran Tony Tucker vom Türsteher und Schläger zum skrupellosen Gangster. Nachdem er sich mit den berüchtigten Kriminellen Craig Rolfe und Pat Tate verbündet, gerät Tucker immer tiefer in einen Strudel aus Drogen und Gewalt.
overview.en: Returning from the Falklands War, a bitter and angry man soon gets into dangerous dealings as he makes a name for himself in the Essex underworld.
Peter Laurence is a political renegade with a common touch. But with enemies closing in on personal and professional secrets, will his bravado save him or see him fall?

title.de: Rock and Roll's Greatest Failure: Otway the Movie
title.en: Rock and Roll's Greatest Failure: Otway the Movie

overview.en: This fan-funded documentary centers around underground music legend John Otway, who discusses how failure has defined him for over 35 years.

overview.de: Oscargekrönter Boxfilm, der Sylvester Stallone über Nacht zum Superstar machte. - Amateurboxer Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) schlägt sich mit miesen Jobs durch. Für einen Promotion-Gag fordert ihn Boxweltmeister Apollo (Carl Weathers) zum Titelkampf heraus. Doch Rocky nimmt die Sache ernst und trainiert verbissen. Im Ring schlägt die Stunde der Entscheidung.
overview.en: A heavyweight champ gives a club fighter (Sylvester Stallone) a title shot.

overview.de: Das grandiose Finale der Rocky-Reihe: raue Ring-Action mit Sylvester Stallone. - Boxlegende Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) backt inzwischen kleine Brötchen und hält mit Anekdoten die Gäste seines Lokals bei Laune. Dann erklärt ein TV-Sender Rocky zum Sieger eines virtuellen Kampfs gegen den amtierenden Champ. Erneut juckt es den Altboxer in den Fäusten. Mit Schwager Paulie bereitet er sich auf den letzten Kampf seiner Karriere vor.
overview.en: Aging Rocky's plan to fight a few small matches escalates into a battle with the world champion.

title.de: Rocky III - Das Auge des Tigers

overview.de: Stallone boxt sich erneut durch. Mit dem Tophit "Eye of the Tiger". - Weltmeister Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) führt ein Leben in Luxus. Dann fordert ihn der schwarze Boxer Clubber Lang (Mr. T.) heraus. Der Champion verliert den Schwergewichtskampf. Der geschlagene Rocky lässt sich von seinem früheren Gegner Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) zu einem Comeback überreden.
overview.en: Rocky Balbao teams up with Apollo Creed to regain his title.

Emma (Kaley Cuoco) and Dave (David Oyelowo) spice up their wedding anniversary with a night of role-play in New York City. But things turn perilous when Emma's secret life as an international assassin, unknown to Dave, is exposed by Bob (Bill Nighy), jeopardizing her family. Emma must rely on her lethal skills and determination to protect her family at all costs.
After being diagnosed with multiple sclerosis, a 21-year-old student goes on a journey of self discovery through New Zealand, Burma and Mongolia.
A small-town teen escapes her abusive parents and hitchhikes her way to Vegas, armed only with some pocket money, street smarts, and a gun.
Sean Connery returns to the role that made him famous, James Bond, in this remake of Thunderball.

overview.de: Nach einem schweren Erdbeben der San Andreas-Verwerfung versuchen ein Helikopter-Pilot und seine Frau, sich nach San Francisco zu ihrer Tochter durchzuschlagen, um sie zu retten.
overview.en: A pilot must rescue his daughter after a massive earthquake.
An American army major's love is put to the test by racial prejudices after falling for the beautiful performer of a famed Japanese dancing troupe.

Popular prank TV show, Scare Campaign, has been entertaining audiences for the last 5 years with its mix of old school scares and hidden camera fun. But as we enter a new age of online TV the producers find themselves up against a new hard edged web series which makes their show look decidedly quaint. It's time to up the ante, but will the team go too far this time, and are they about to prank the

title.de: Schimpansen im Kongo mit Jane Goodall
title.en: Schimpansen im Kongo mit Jane Goodall
Schumacher '94 - The Birth of a Legend

overview.de: Corinna Schumacher, Flavio Briatore und andere enge Vertraute blicken zurück auf die turbulente Rennsaison, aus der Schumi als Formel-1-Legende hervorging.
overview.en: In 1994, a 25-year-old Michael Schumacher won his first F1 World Championship during a racing season defined by unprecedented tragedy and controversy.

title.de: SCHW31NS7EIGER: Memories - Von Anfang bis Legende
title.en: SCHW31NS7EIGER: Memories - Von Anfang bis Legende

overview.en: Social media stars unite at a haunted house to play Metaxu, an online séance game, only to find they have unleashed an evil entity.
After the death of her mother, a lonely young girl's grandfather sues for custody and the puppets made by her artist father suddenly come to life.
Sarah Jessica Parker stars in HBO's hit series about a thirtysomething writer whose life and friendships are fodder for her weekly column.

title.de: Sex and the City - Der Film

overview.de: Anwältin Miranda und Charlotte sind verheiratet mit Kind, Vamp Samantha ist für ihren jungen Posterboy nach L.A. gezogen und Autorin Carrie freut sich aufs Wohnen mit Traummann Mr. Big. Dennoch ziehen Gewitter auf. Erst gesteht Mirandas Mann einen One-Night-Stand, dann bekommt Big am Tag der Hochzeit kalte Füße. Der Destruktion folgt eine lange Wiederaufbauphase. Sie beginnt beim Viererurlaub ...
overview.en: Carrie, Samantha, Charlotte, and Miranda are back in this film continuation of the series, set four years after the finale.

title.en: The Coed and the Zombie Stoner

overview.en: When a nerdy sorority girl falls in love with a zombie, it's only a matter of time before a zombie apocalypse is unleashed on campus. The sorority girl discovers that weed is the cure--now she must smoke out the entire school before it's too late.
After Zach receives a strange message from his dad, he gathers some friends and travels to Death Valley to meet him, never expecting what’s to come...

In this essayistic travelogue, Mirka Duijn explores the history of Shangri-La - the famous paradise from James Hilton's novel, 'Lost Horizon'. Two decades ago, a Tibetan region in China, Deqin, claimed it was the original Shangri-La of legend. This rich and complex story follows Mirka's quest to find answers, only resulting in an entanglement of facts and fictions, truths and lies.

SimsalaGrimm Season 1 (Re-version) takes a fresh look at the heritage of fairy tales. The two witty wanderers Yoyo and Doc Croc travel on their magical book through the enchanted world of Simsala. Despite their differences, they are best friends.

title.de: Sinatra: All or Nothing at All
title.en: Sinatra: All or Nothing at All

overview.en: Sinatra: All or Nothing at All is an American documentary film that premiered in two parts on April 5 and 6, 2015 on HBO.

Jimmy Skinford is on the run with the only person he can trust, Zophia, a woman hunted by every crook in town for her coveted immortality. To stop the relentless violence and get their lives back they must search through Zophia’s past to find a cure.

A wealthy, dysfunctional family gathers for a reunion on a secluded island only to learn they'll be pitted against one another in a cruel game of life and death, all while being stalked by a mysterious masked killer.
Investigative filmmaker Rebecca Cappelli exposes the harrowing truth behind the use of fur, leather, and wool in the luxury fashion industry.
A law student facing debt and a high tuition bill gets in over his head and meets a zany cast of characters when he breaks the law for cash.
A U.S. Army sniper and his partner try to rescue a congressman abducted by the Taliban. But when the mission fails, they are left behind enemy lines.

A South African love guru loses faith in love after suffering the humiliation of being dumped on her wedding day. However, she meets a Nigerian photographer who is running away from his own love woes. Will he be the one to restore her faith in love and how far is she willing to keep the new love she's found?

Sonic, his friends, and the evil Dr. Eggman are sucked into a warp! They find themselves in the human world where Sonic finds a new friend, a young boy named Chris. Sonic speeds through battles with Eggman, trying to retrieve all of the Chaos Emeralds so that everyone can go back home!

title.de: Soulfood - Familie geht durch den Magen

overview.en: A boy with Israeli and Palestinian family that are always at odds tries to bring unity by way of a perfect meal after he is mentored by a gifted chef.
Send in the clowns, this cult classic is back! One-of-a-kind alien invasion sci-fi featuring blood drinking alien clowns harvesting a small city.

overview.de: Nach Avengers: Endgame muss sich Spider-Man neuen Bedrohungen in einer Welt stellen, die sich für immer verändert hat.
overview.en: Spider-Man's European vacation takes a dangerous turn when Nick Fury recruits him to investigate mysterious attacks across the continent.

Set in modern-day Berlin, Spides follows Nora (Laurenti Sellers) a young woman who wakes from a coma without any memory of her previous life after taking a mysterious drug; local police detective David Leonhart (Falk Hentschel) and his partner Nique Navar (Florence Kasumba) are hunting down that drug in relation to dozens of missing teens.
A Special Boat Service operative for MI6 and his American counterpart are tasked with scoping an Iranian laboratory making deadly biochemical weapons.
A war vet enters a notorious fight club to avenge the savage beating of his brother and rescue his hometown from the control of a corrupt businessman.
Amanda Waller, the head of A.R.G.U.S., sends the Suicide Squad on a mission to another world -- "ISEKAI"!
Documentarian Morgan Spurlock opens his very own fast food restaurant in order to investigate and expose the health hazards of the industry.

overview.de: Jensen Ackles und Jared Padalecki spielen Sam und Dean Winchester, zwei Brüder, die in den ganzen USA übernatürliche Mächte bekämpfen und rätselhafte Mordfälle aufklären.
overview.en: The thrilling yet terrifying journeys of Sam and Dean Winchester, two brothers who face an increasingly sinister landscape as they hunt monsters.

Ken, a lackadaisical man who has given up on his dreams, finds an outdated, half-broken robot named "Tang" in his backyard. After finding out Tang has no memory of its origin or identity, the two set off on an intercontinental journey to repair Tang and unravel the mystery of its creation. Little did they know a grand adventure was waiting for them...©2022 “TANG AND ME” FILM PARTNERS
As they learn their routes around the busy city, Tayo and his little bus friends discover new sights and go on exciting adventures every day.

title.de: Teen Witch - Hokuspokus in der Highschool

overview.en: On the cusp of her 16th birthday, a high-school nobody discovers she has magical powers that may help her cast a spell on her dream guy.

overview.de: Eine Killermaschine aus der Zukunft wird ins Jahr 1984 geschickt, um Sarah Connor zu töten.
overview.en: Un cyborg asesino viaja al pasado para matar a una mujer cuyo hijo por nacer liderará la lucha humana contra máquinas en una carrera desesperada.
After miraculously healing from a life-threatening illness, a journalist’s search of the ‘lost’ technology that saved him leads him to Nikola Tesla.

overview.de: Robert De Niro spielt in einer Doppelrolle zwei Mafiabosse: Im New York der 50er kämpfen Frank Costello und Vito Genovese um die Macht in der Cosa Nostra. Inszeniert von Barry Levinson.
overview.en: The Alto Knights stars Academy Award winner Robert De Niro in a dual role, directed by Academy Award-winning filmmaker Barry Levinson.

According to her detractors, Ruth Paine is a government agent who helped frame Lee Harvey Oswald as the assassin of the president. But to her defenders, she is simply an innocent bystander caught up in history. The Assassination and Mrs Paine juxtaposes Ruth's first-hand account alongside the assassination researchers who suspect her and the defenders of the official story with whom she sides.
In 1962, a United States astronaut of Romanian origins sets out on an unprecedented space quest, where philosophical and emotional incidents occur.

title.de: The Barkley Marathons: The Race That Eats Its Young
title.en: The Barkley Marathons: The Race That Eats Its Young

overview.en: Inspired by an infamous prison escape, runners compete in a cult-like race that’s only had 10 people finish its arduous course in 25 years.

A group of friends travel to a secluded campsite to find a mysterious bell that summons a murderer if you ring it at midnight. They hear ghost stories about the creepy Keeper, who manages the land, killing any kids who dare to ring the haunted bell. After unleashing a malevolent curse, they turn on each other, caught between the relentless Keeper and the looming threat of possession.

overview.de: Leonard und Sheldon sind brillante Physiker, aber ihre Genialität hilft ihnen nicht im Umgang mit Menschen, insbesondere mit Frauen. All das beginnt sich zu ändern, als die freigeistige Schönheit Penny nebenan einzieht. Sheldon ist damit zufrieden, seine Nächte mit ihren sozial gestörten Freunden beim Klingonen-Boggle zu verbringen. Leonard jedoch sieht in Penny ein ganz neues Universum.
overview.en: Leonard and Sheldon are brilliant physicists, the kind of "beautiful minds" that understand how the universe works. But none of that genius helps them interact with people, especially women. All this begins to change when a free-spirited beauty named Penny moves in next door. Sheldon, Leonard's roommate, is quite content spending his nights playing Klingon Boggle with their socially dysfunctional friends, fellow Caltech scientists Wolowitz and Koothrappali. However, Leonard sees in Penny a whole new universe of possibilities... including love.

Set in gritty London, Olga Kurylenko plays a tough motorbike courier who discovers that one of the packages she's transporting is a bomb set to kill Nick (Amit Shah, Final Score), the only witness able to testify against ruthless crime lord Ezekiel Mannings (Gary Oldman, The Dark Knight). Also starring Dermot Mulroney (Homecoming), William Moseley (Narnia) and Alicia Agneson (Vikings).
Louise and Michael return home to say goodbye to their dying father but soon begin to suffer from a darkness marked by waking nightmares.

overview.de: Der Terrorist Bane bringt Bruce mit seinem skrupellosen Vorgehen dazu, sein selbstgewähltes Exil aufzugeben. Doch selbst mit Cape und Maske, scheint der Dunkle Ritter Bane unterlegen.
overview.en: Batman re-emerges from his self-imposed exile to battle a merciless terrorist named Bane.

overview.de: Satanisten rauben das Turiner Grabtuch. Ihr Ziel: Sie wollen aus DNA-Fragmenten Jesus klonen - als ultimative Opfergabe für den Teufel. Tschechischer Endzeit-Horror.
overview.en: Después de que un culto satánico roba el Sudario de Turín con fines malvados, el Arcángel Miguel regresa a la Tierra para detener su plan.

Inches away from conquering the world, the devil is foiled by a hero and finds himself in modern-day Tokyo. With no real-world skills to speak of, the devil is forced to make ends meet flipping burgers at a fast food joint!

In the near future a high-tech implant connects us all to THE FEED. Tom’s father created The Feed, but Tom has come to fear it. When something - or someone - invades The Feed, everyone is at risk. As Tom’s family hide the truth about what is happening, Tom realises that he has to try to save the world from their twisted creation.

overview.de: In diesem atemberaubenden Thriller muss eine Gruppe in Texas zusammenhalten, um eine scheinbar unaufhaltsame Welle der Gewalt zu überleben, die die Nation erschüttert.
overview.en: A group of Texas ranchers fight back when masked killers decide that the annual Purge does not stop at daybreak and keep attacking people.

Succession is a very important matter in the royal family. The line of succession delegates who will inherit the throne and become the next king or queen of Great Britain. A line that has changed. A line that is determined by descent, gender, legitimacy, and religion.
Thirty years after 100 guests at Cyprus’ Hotel Gula were poisoned to death on New Year’s Eve, an American TV crew prepares to exploit the mystery.

overview.de: Sophie zieht von Neuengland nach Ost-Texas und wird in das faszinierende Leben der wohlhabenden Margot verwickelt, deren Hausfrauen-Clique mörderische Geheimnisse verbirgt.
overview.en: Sophie O'Neil and her family move from the East Coast to deep East Texas, where she succumbs to socialite Margo Bank's irresistible charms – and finds her life consumed by obsession, seduction, and murder.
Explore the rise of mixed martial arts, the fastest growing sport in the world, and the struggles and triumphs of its superstars and up-and-comers.

title.de: The Inspectors - Der Tod kommt mit der Post

overview.en: An unlikely duo of U.S. postal inspectors must rise to the occasion when a mail bomb kills a suburban couple and their son becomes the prime suspect.
Eccentric filmmaker Stephen Groo pursues actor Jack Black, trying to recruit him to star in his comedy about a romance between a human and an elf.
10 years after the death of their son in an accident, a divorced couple is reunited by a series of supernatural events.

title.de: The King’s Speech - Die Rede des Königs

overview.de: Colin Firth sucht als stotternder König Hilfe bei einem Sprachtherapeuten, um sein Volk in einer Rede auf den Krieg gegen Hitler einzustimmen. Mit viel Witz erzähltes Historiendrama. Vier Oscars! - Öffentliche Auftritte geraten dem Herzog von York (Colin Firth) zum Fiasko: Er stottert. Sprachtherapeut Logue (Geoffrey Rush) soll helfen. Die Dienste des respektlosen Zungenklempners werden immer dringender gebraucht: 1937 wird der Herzog neuer König von England. Und nicht nur die Krönung will ohne zu stottern bestanden sein. Der König muss sein Volk bald unfallfrei auf den Krieg gegen Hitler einstimmen.
overview.en:
After the death of his father King George V (Michael Gambon) and the scandalous abdication of King Edward VIII (Guy Pearce), Bertie (Colin Firth) who has suffered from a debilitating speech impediment all his life, is suddenly crowned King George VI of England. With his country on the brink of war and in desperate need of a leader, his wife, Elizabeth (Helena Bonham Carter), the future Queen Mother, arranges for her husband to see an eccentric speech therapist, Lionel Logue (Geoffrey Rush). After a rough start, the two delve into an unorthodox course of treatment and eventually form an unbreakable bond. With the support of Logue, his family, his government and Winston Churchill (Timothy Spall), the King will overcome his stammer and deliver a radio-address that inspires his people and unites them in battle. 
Based on the true story of King George VI, The King's Speech follows the Royal Monarch's quest to find his voice.
This Sundance Festival favorite blends vivid, electrifying stock car racing footage with a small town’s fight to keep its identity and love of racing.

Disillusioned with his all-American life, a young man is confronted by thoughts of suicide. To save his life, he embarks on a journey into the depths of the Amazon rainforest, where stories of Shamans and Ayahuasca ceremonies promise psychic healing. His experiences with tribal medicines are life-changing - but he is also forced to confront the parts of himself he has long struggled to understand.
Winter, 1843. A young woman is under investigation following the mysterious death of her family's matriarch. Her recollection of the events sheds new light on the ageless forces behind the tragedy.

title.de: The Legend of Sleeping Beauty - Dornröschen

overview.en: When a young Prince and his trusted aide learn of a beautiful Princess's cursed eternal slumber, they embark on a journey to rescue her.

title.de: The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen - From Villainess to Savior
title.en: The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen: From Villainess to Savior

overview.en: Our protagonist was just reincarnated as Princess Pride Royal Ivy, the last boss and ultimate villain of her favorite otome game. But evil just isn’t her style, so she’ll use Pride’s powerful abilities to sow peace and love instead of discord!

title.de: The Nest: Don't Let The Bed Bugs Bite

overview.en: As a mom suspects her daughter may be infected by a parasite, those she trusts most push her into a spiral of addiction, destruction and sacrifice.

We've all heard of the atomic bomb, but in the late 1950s, an idea was conceived of a bomb which would maximize damage to people, but minimize damage to buildings and vital infrastructure: perfect for an occupying army. This is the story of a man and his bomb: a melding of world events and scientific discovery inspire the neutron bomb, one of the most hated nuclear weapons ever invented.

title.de: The Oldham Man and the Sea
title.en: The Oldham Man and the Sea

overview.en: Akatsuki Iride is a popular live streamer for the game The Ones Within –Genome. But what was once fantasy quickly becomes reality when he and seven others are transported into a game world that livestreams their every move.
Concerned about her 8-year-old son's erratic and disturbing behavior, a mother's investigations lead to a discovery of dark forces at work.

overview.de: In der einen Nacht des Jahres, in der Gewaltverbrechen folgenlos bleiben, kämpft eine Familie in der trügerischen Idylle einer exklusiven Wohnsiedlung ums Überleben.
overview.en: A family struggles to survive the night during a government-sanctioned event in which all crime -- including murder -- is legal.
An optometrist possesses a pair of shoes that have deadly consequences for those who wear them.
A captivating blend of personal stories invites viewer into the inner sanctum of King Charles, Queen Camilla, Prince William and Princess Kate.

Set thousands of years in our future, the story follows three heroes, Amberle, an Elvin Princess, Eretria, a Human Rover, and Wil, a Half-Elf, Half-Human, as they embark on a quest to stop an evil Demon army.

From MAMORU OSHII, the world-acclaimed director of Ghost in the Shell comes an award-winning story of an exciting but endless war with heroes too young to understand the meaning of their battles. A group of eternally young fighter pilots known as Kildren experience the sudden loss of innocence as they battle the enemy in astonishing dogfights above the clouds. With his only childhood memory...

The Strain is a high concept thriller that tells the story of Dr. Ephraim Goodweather, the head of the CDC Canary Team in New York City. He and his team are called upon to investigate a viral outbreak with hallmarks of an ancient and evil strain of vampirism.  As the strain spreads, Eph and his team wage war for the fate of humanity itself.
An elderly woman battling Alzheimer's agrees to let a film crew document her condition, but what they discover is something far more malevolent.
An Oslo detective with a painful past returns to his native Iceland to help a dedicated cop hunt a serial killer with a link to a mysterious photo.

In 2022 Iceland killed 160 Fin Whales, the second largest animal in the world, despite the International Whaling Commission deeming it endangered and banning its hunting worldwide. This documentary delves into the violations of international regulations, ghost ships and omertà behind a lucrative business aimed at Japan, which still utilises archaic & cruel methods of hunting these creatures.

overview.de: Die unabhängige Louise überredet ihre schüchterne Freundin Thelma, ihren dominanten Ehemann zu verlassen und mit ihr zu einem Roadtrip aufzubrechen. Doch nach einer Eskalation in einer Bar müssen die beiden fliehen. Auf ihrer rasanten Reise quer durchs Land entdecken die beiden ungeahnte Freiheit.
overview.en: Two women embark on a road trip across the American southwest to escape the law, after one kills a man to save the other from a brutal attack.

title.de: TikTok, die mächtigste App der Welt

overview.en: In 19th century Sweden, a couple moves to a remote cabin. The man begins hunting in the forest and provokes the ire of the baron who owns the land.

The creative force behind Appleseed returns with two haunting vignettes about mankind’s ruthless quest to build a future in the vacuum of space. Elliptical Orbit: a mysterious space freighter carries a power source vital to Earth’s survival. Symbiotic Planet: Aon and Elena—star-crossed lovers from rival countries struggle to survive a deadly alien outbreak!
To the End captures the emergence of a new generation of American environmental leaders and the movement behind the most sweeping climate change legislation in U.S. history.
A mysterious drifter who maneuvers into the life of an ambitious businessman gets introduced to an intoxicating world of power and sensuality.

title.de: Tom Petty, Somewhere You Feel Free
title.en: Tom Petty, Somewhere You Feel Free

overview.en: Extensive interviews and footage from an archive of 16mm film give an intimate look at Tom Petty during the making of his 1994 album Wildflowers.
A look at the legends of cinema and music who were taken too soon.
Members of a religious community try to save the soul of a possessed boy and his child cohorts after he escapes from an asylum and starts murdering anyone who gets in his way.
A gruff bounty hunter travels back in time to 1980s Los Angeles to stop a twisted criminal who can transform people into zombie-like creatures.

The giant underground creatures that terrorized a desert town in Tremors are now plowing their way through Mexican oil fields, gobbling up everything and everyone around-and only one man can stop them!

The stakes are raised for survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) in his most dangerous monster hunt yet. When Gummer's hired to capture a deadly Ass Blaster terrorising South Africa, he and his new sidekick, Travis Welker (Jamie Kennedy), engage in a battle of survival against the fercely aggressive Ass Blasters and Graboids.

title.de: Tremors 6 - Ein kalter Tag in der Hölle
title.en: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell

overview.en: Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and Travis Welker (Jamie Kennedy) find themselves in a fight for survival after investigating deadly giant worm attacks in the Canadian arctic.

When a group of wealthy trophy hunters genetically modify Graboid eggs to create the ultimate hunting experience, it isn’t long before their prey escape the confines of their small island and begin terrorizing the inhabitants of a nearby island research facility.
Jared, an indigenous teen struggling to keep his family afloat, meets a mysterious stranger, who turns his whole world upside down.

Pride, Envy, Wrath, Sloth, Greed, Gluttony, Lust. These are the seven sins laid upon seven girls who rule over Biblia Academy. To retake his world, the boy decides he must control these sins... The boy, Arata Kasuga, has had the world he knows by a mysterious "Collapse Phenomenon", and his cousin Hijiri disappears into another dimension. To understand the Collapse Phenomenon and win back his co...
Cuando un importante sindicato del crimen ataca a la hija de un multimillonario, son mercenarios contra asesinos en una guerra total.

A successful realtor and soccer mom's life is turned upside down when neo-Nazis unleash a troll storm against her and her family. In the face of an alarming growth of American fascism, she finds solidarity with her community by standing up, fighting back and ultimately filing a landmark case for the First Amendment, setting a precedent that could shape America's future.
Fifteen years after her dad’s murder, a 21-year-old raised as a misfit by her mom in isolation begins a mission to honor his memory and get revenge.

title.de: Under Deadly Skies: Ukraine's Eastern Front
title.en: Under Deadly Skies: Ukraine's Eastern Front

overview.en: A group of young Syrian women embark upon on a radical project: producing a play that lays bare the culture of misogyny and sexual abuse that has blighted the lives of females in their country for generations. Farah, Eliana, Inana, Souhir and Grace want to blow the whistle on women's oppression and they fan out through the war-weary city to gather stories that will form the basis of their play.

From hooliganism and violence through to the ecstasy and the rise of rave culture, Andy Swallow, co-founder of West Ham's ICF and later Centreforce 883, opens up about his life for the very first time.
Julie’s friends find her new love to be grody to the max, leaving her caught up in a culture clash between her Valley lifestyle and her punk hunk.
The morning after a one night stand, Jennifer finds a nasty gash on her stomach, an inability to see her reflection, and a taste for human blood.
Lucie Blackman – a tall, blond, twenty-one-year-old – stepped out into the vastness of the Tokyo night in the summer of 2000 and disappeared forever.
Con una avalancha de casos inquietantes, el detective Travis descubre que su decimosexto año en la policía será el más importante de su carrera.

title.de: Voyage to Himalaya - The Kangchenjunga Expedition 2022
title.en: Voyage to Himalaya - The Kangchenjunga Expedition 2022

overview.en: Revisiting the spectacular Himalayas on the route for ascension of Kangchenjunga Massif of 8.586m, the third highest peak of the world along with two Romanian climbers, part of an International expedition.
Tasked with finding a new planet, a group of astronauts set off into deep space, where their mission descends into chaos and paranoia.

An epidemic of deadly insomnia spreads like wildfire through Stockholm, triggering a wave of strange events, accidents, and violence. As chaos engulfs the Swedish capital, a disgraced minister must choose between the nation and his family, while a resourceful ambulance nurse and a self-absorbed teenage influencer fight to stay afloat through the disaster.

overview.de: Nach Jahren kehrt Ex-Soldat Chris Vaughn in sein Heimatstädtchen zurück, wo statt einer Holzfabrik ein Casino mit Striptease, Drogen und Falschspiel wichtigster Arbeitgeber geworden ist. Nach übler Schlägerei und der Überdosis von Chris' Neffen, sieht Chris rot. Er schnappt sich einen Holzpfosten, schlägt das Casino kurz und klein und wird infolgedessen zum Sheriff ernannt. Das lässt sich die Bande örtlicher Drogendealer nicht gerne gefallen...
overview.en: When Chris Vaughn returns to his hometown to find work, he finds that the lumber mill has closed and the town's big business is now a casino. Aided by his friend Ray Templeton, Vaughn tries to make a stand against the area's crime and corruption.

When a cartel shooting leaves several detectives dead, an aging police officer must retrieve an eyewitness and escort her across the Mexican border. Once there, he finds not only his old opinions challenged, but that bad hombres on both sides of the border are now gunning for him and his witness.

title.de: Water Life: Die Wiege des Lebens

overview.en: Water Life follows the water in all of its manifestations, discovering the things that make it so fundamental to life, showing a fascinating and gripping world.

title.de: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
title.en: We Have Always Lived in the Castle

overview.en: A cousin’s visit to a remote mansion, where two sisters and a deranged uncle live after the murky deaths of their family, reveals scandalous secrets.

Despite having successful careers, two thirty-something BFFs never stop hearing that they need to find a man. When a handsome pastor arrives for the Christmas season, the ladies try to one-up each other in an attempt to gain his affection.

title.de: Weihnachtszauber - Ein Kuss kann alles verändern

overview.en: After a spontaneous kiss, a struggling designer falls in love with her demanding boss's boyfriend as she decorates his home for a Christmas party.

title.de: Wer hat eigentlich die Liebe erfunden?
When Will Ayumu Make His Move?
title.en: When Will Ayumu Make His Move?

overview.en: Ayumu just fell in love at first sight with Urushi and joined the illegitimate Shogi Club! But Ayumu has vowed not to confess his feelings until he can best Urushi, and he has a long way to go before he can stand up to her strategic brilliance.

Modern Whitechapel is experiencing déjà vu with a series of murders that exactly copy those of perpetrated by Jack the Ripper. Can Detective Chandler, a rookie when it comes to murder cases, bring safety back to the streets of Whitechapel?

For Jack Palmer, finding Ange Leoni to give him documents concerning property he's inherited is just another job. However, it turns out that Leoni lives in Corsica and is a high-ranking member of the independence movement being sought by police.

overview.de: Jeremy Renner ermittelt in diesem Thrillerdrama als traumatisierter Trapper im schneebedeckten Wyoming. - Fährtenleser Cory Lambert (Jeremy Renner) stößt bei der Jagd auf die Leiche der 18-jährigen Natalie aus dem nahen Indianer-Reservat. Anscheinend ist sie auf der Flucht vor ihrem Vergewaltiger in den Tod gerannt. Weil die lokale Polizei überfordert ist, wird die junge FBI-Agentin Jane Banner (Elizabeth Olsen) mit den Ermittlungen beauftragt. Immer noch von dem Verlust seiner eigenen Teenager-Tochter traumatisiert, bietet Cory Jane seine Hilfe an.
overview.en: A veteran hunter helps an FBI agent investigate the murder of a young woman on a Wyoming Native American reservation.

A reimagining of the cult book and film Christiane F. and with a soundtrack in collaboration with the David Bowie Estate, 'We Children from Bahnhof Zoo' is an addictive, provocative coming of age drama which follows six teenagers in 1970s West Berlin as they become seduced by the city's underworld, with life changing consequences.
From Zach Braff, the creator of Garden State, comes this touching and funny story about being a parent, spouse and child...all at the same time.
Interviews and performances with some of punk rock’s most important bands including Girlschool, the Slits, Mania D and Siouxsie and the Banshees.
Filmed over several years, this documentary shadows the medic teams at the Italian Grand Tour Cycling race to reveal unseen footage of the riders.
An immersive and gorgeously shot ocean voyage that takes you deep underwater to show the various mysterious sea life that needs our protection.

This gripping documentary unveils the world before the WWI, the tensions simmering beneath empires, and the Sarajevo assassination that ignited the deadliest conflict yet. A clash of nations, a war unforeseen history was never the same.

title.de: WWII Declassified: The New World Rescues the Old
title.en: WWII Declassified: The New World Rescues the Old

overview.en: From the retreat at Dunkirk to the invasion of Normandy, this documentary follows WWII's turning points. Witness the Allies' struggle, strategic battles, and ultimate push toward victory as they fight to reclaim Europe from Nazi control.
Hoping for a letter of recommendation from the wealthy parents of her classmate, Eden attends a coveted party that turns into a fight for her life.
Xavier, a.k.a Youn'G, and his friends navigate adolescence, cultivating deep bonds while he endeavors to conquer his true love's heart.
An aspirational kid looking to become the Duel Monsters champion and an odd visitor in search of his lost memories team up to search for rare cards.
Un equipo de héroes cotidianos debe transportar al único sobreviviente conocido del virus zombi al último laboratorio viral en funcionamiento.
Two survivors of a zombie attack are forced into a brutal battle against undead gladiators.
A man who made his name fighting the Sioux returns to the West after the war to forge a peace treaty that’s undermined by gold-hungry frontiersmen.
Featuring a local two-faced television team in rural Georgia. The two reporters, Dariko and Khaka, follow the most diverse stories, from elections to fashion shows for teenagers.

More journalists have been killed over a year in the Israel-Gaza war than in any other conflict, since data has been collected. This hellish portrait follows three Palestinian journalists in Gaza as they are forced put their lives at risk while trying to report. They feel obligated to continue, even though they know they are risking their lives in a conflict that spares no one.

Sound engineer Mohamed Yaghi works tirelessly to record sounds in the Gaza Strip, leading an auditory journey through four stories, each character reflecting the war's impact since October 7th. We witness how the sounds of this devastated region have been transformed. A fascinating and original perspective on how humanity endures horror and maintains hope against the odds.

Can a child recover from spending half his life in ISIS captivity? After two and a half years in captivity, Imad, his little brother Idan, and their mother Ghazala are released into a displaced persons' camp in Kurdistan. Healing from the trauma is hard for all of them, but it seems Imad is having a particularly tough time.
Where it all began! Strangers at first, a Mumbai-based girl and an ‘Assal Punekar’ boy wind up spending a day together in Pune and forge a life-long bond.

overview.de: Srimathi is a 30 year old unmarried woman, with a dead end job, a dysfunctional family and a goal to win back her ancestral house. For that, she needs to raise a lot of money in a short period of time. Seeing a business oppurtunity, she decides to start a bar in her village. This is the journey of Srimathi, battling various societal and moral obstacles along the way.
overview.en: Srimathi is a 30 year old unmarried woman, with a dead end job, a dysfunctional family and a goal to win back her ancestral house. For that, she needs to raise a lot of money in a short period of time. Seeing a business oppurtunity, she decides to start a bar in her village. This is the journey of Srimathi, battling various societal and moral obstacles along the way.

Love Mocktail is a romantic and fun film about the protagonist Aadi's quest for love. Life takes him through a rollercoaster ride and goes through varied experience at several stages throughout his search for true love. Does Aadi finally find his soulmate?

title.de: マロニエ王国の七人の騎士
title.en: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom

overview.en: Japanese sorcery begins here -the story of the most powerful Yin Yang Master, Abe no Seimei, who really existed during the Heian period. Experience “Sorcery Entertainment” like never before, which uncover the secrets of the young Seimei!©2024 "The Yin Yang Master Zero" Film Partners
A two-woman show about friendship, periods, sex after marriage, body image, and parenting failures from comics Kristin Hensley and Jen Smedley.

overview.de: Die Gründerin einer Dating-App und ihr Konkurrent stellen ihre Theorien zur Liebe auf die Probe: Kann man in 60 Tagen den*die Richtige*n finden?
overview.en: Tara's dating app values compatibility over chemistry, but meeting the thrill-seeking investor Matthew makes her question her theory of love.

overview.de: Paris, 2014. Die Tontechnikerin und DJ Céline erwartet ihr erstes Kind - doch schwanger ist sie nicht. In wenigen Monaten wird ihre Frau Nadia eine Tochter zur Welt bringen. Während Nadia zwischen Übelkeit und Atemnot im zahnärztlichen Notdienst arbeitet, übt Céline das Babyhandling an den Kindern eines Kollegen. Dieses Chaos soll bald ihr Alltag werden?
overview.en: Céline (Ella Rumpf) is awaiting the birth of her first child, carried by her wife Nadia (Monia Chokri). As the due date approaches, Céline faces questions of legitimacy and identity, shaped by family, friends, and the legal framework surrounding her role as a mother.
Cinco historias se entrelazan durante una tarde en Nueva Orleans sin saber los protagonistas que están en medio de una conspiración religiosa.
A group of teens and entrepreneurs come together for an impossible mission that gives them mere hours to create a business solution to cure cancer.

Trace the meteoric rise of 5SOS from their humble beginnings in a Sydney suburb to worldwide fame in this unauthorized, very first and in-depth biography, featuring electrifying archive footage and intimate interviews with the boys.
A newly laid-off construction worker and single dad is forced to take a job working for the real-estate broker who heartlessly evicted his family.
Twin preteen sisters chart their way through 21st century adolescence by hijacking a children's movie that tells the story of their everyday lives.
Explores the early life of Emily Dickinson as a schoolgirl to her later years as a reclusive but unknown talent and her attachments to her family.

overview.de: Kati ist gehörlos, Florian ist blind. Als sie sich im Dialoghaus Hamburg begegnen, entsteht eine eigene Sprache - jenseits von Worten, getragen von Nähe und Mut. Familie und Umfeld stellen die Beziehung auf die Probe. Ihre Liebe wirkt für Außenstehende kaum möglich und entfaltet Kraft. Der Film zeigt, wie Nähe entstehen kann, wo andere nur Grenzen sehen.
overview.en: Kati ist gehörlos, Florian ist blind. Als sie sich im Dialoghaus Hamburg begegnen, entsteht eine eigene Sprache - jenseits von Worten, getragen von Nähe und Mut. Familie und Umfeld stellen die Beziehung auf die Probe. Ihre Liebe wirkt für Außenstehende kaum möglich und entfaltet Kraft. Der Film zeigt, wie Nähe entstehen kann, wo andere nur Grenzen sehen.
Documentary offers nuanced view of life in women's psychiatric ward, housing convicted patients.
As the Battle of the Bulge approaches, a group of high-ranking WWII officers may let their personal grudges get in the way of their success.

title.en: For the Love of the Mustang

overview.en: Three trainers help acclimate mustangs to their new life in Europe as part of an effort to shed light on the plight of this mighty American horse.

title.de: Bad Times at the El Royale
title.en: Bad Times at the El Royale

overview.de: Eine verhängnisvolle Nacht in einem abgewrackten Hotel: Jeff Bridges, Chris Hemsworth, Dakota Johnson und Jon Hamm treffen in dem Thriller als Fremde mit dunklen Geheimnissen aufeinander.
overview.en: Seven strangers, each with a secret, meet at a rundown hotel with a dark past.
A lawyer takes on a food giant for workers sterilized by a pesticide. Will justice prevail?
Never have the stakes and the waves been so high. An immersive journey into the heart of Cox's Bazar in Bangladesh.

title.de: Ben Stokes: Phoenix from the Ashes
title.en: Ben Stokes: Phoenix from the Ashes

overview.en: A refreshingly honest film about an extraordinary cricketer. Directors Chris Grubb and Luke Mellows were allowed unprecedented access to Ben’s life with interviews and insight by Sam Mendes.

Filmmaker Alex Pitstra has lived his life pulled between cultures. Raised in Holland by his mother, Anneke, he longed to know more about Mohsen, his absent Tunisian father. Alex was the result of a holiday romance, conceived after 36-year-old divorcee Anneke met 23-year-old Mohsen in Tunisia. In Bezness as Usual he attempts to get to know his father and make sense of his roots.

Four best friends from Minnesota trade in their hockey sticks and high-school life to pursue pop music stardom in Los Angeles as a boy band. Kendall, Logan, James and Carlos find out life in Hollywood is not all about the parties and girls.

title.de: Biohack Yourself: Activation Beyond the Quantum
title.en: Biohack Yourself: Activation Beyond the Quantum

overview.en: Biohack Yourself: Activation Beyond The Quantum, dives into advanced therapies like red light, PEMF, and PEMA. This documentary explores how cutting-edge energy-based modalities can enhance cellular health, recovery, and vitality.
Black Ice follows Alice Watters and Jimmy Devlin (rising stars Jane McGrath and Killian Scott) as they attempt to break out of a clandestine Irish border road-racing scene into legit rally driving.

title.de: Bloodbath at the House of Death
title.en: Bloodbath at the House of Death

overview.en: Six scientists face batty situations and cheesy satanic priests as they bumble through a manor where 18 people were mysteriously killed one night.
A dramatic scenario has devastating personal consequences for six people around the world who travel to Pamplona for a festival in 2012.
A woman’s happy life falls apart when she is falsely accused of murder, because a serial killer has obtained her DNA to implicate her in his crimes.
When a Flemish band competing for a European title suddenly loses its soloist, it tries to steal a very talented musician from a rival Walloon band.
In Italy working alone on a volcano site, a geologist slips into an underground hole and injures her leg with no hope of anyone coming to rescue her.

overview.de: Nachdem der plötzliche Tod ihres Vaters sie in das gnadenlose Ökosystem einer öffentlichen Highschool zwingt, gerät Carrie in einen viralen Mobbing-Skandal, der ihre Gemeinde erschüttert. Neben der beiläufigen Grausamkeit des Social-Media-Zeitalters muss sie sich auch mit mysteriösen telekinetischen Kräften auseinandersetzen, die parallel zu ihrer Pubertät erwachen.
overview.en: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.
In this spoof, the heads of the allied spy forces call Sir James Bond out of retirement to fight the power of SMERSH.

title.de: Caveman - Der aus der Höhle kam

overview.en: Set in prehistoric times, a thoughtful-but-goofy cave dweller tries to woo a gorgeous woman in his tribe away from her much stronger and dumber mate.

Lucas Simons, an 11-year-old filmmaker, is obsessed with death after the loss of his brother. When Lucas accidentally captures a mysterious presence in one of his films, he inadvertently becomes a YouTube phenomenon.
Rafa Ortiz, a celebrated pioneer of big waterfall kayaking, pushes his sport to the limit when he dares to dream the impossible – kayaking over Niagara Falls.
Even though child killer Kemper is locked up in an asylum, he finds a way to continue his bloody spree through his devoted servant, who's eager to exact vengeance on those who put away his master.
Based on sordid tales from Charles Bukowski, this film follows a bumbling young man's twisted sex education over three crucial nights across 20 years.

title.en: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? On the Side: Sword Oratoria

overview.en: Ais Wallenstein and the Loki Familia take to the dungeons once more. This time, there may be more lurking than mere monsters.
The affluent world of a Fifth Avenue art-collecting couple is upended when they take in an injured young man claiming to be the son of Sidney Poitier.

title.en: The Simple Life of Noah Dearborn

overview.en: A 91-year-old woodworker finds an unexpected ally in his fight to keep his Georgia land from being taken by a scheming mall developer.
After World War III has ended life in the Northern Hemisphere and as the fallout heads for Melbourne, a sub of scientists investigate cyptic signals.

Influenced by Italian neorealism, Wadjda is a heartfelt and charming tale about a child’s conviction against the odds. Both the first woman director from Saudi Arabia, and the first filmmaker to entirely shoot a film there, Haifaa Al-Mansour crafts this delightful hymn to the heft of small battles.

title.de: Das Recht auf Rache - Im Fadenkreuz des Clans

overview.en: Trapped in a platonic marriage, middle-aged Gina spices things up with an idea for an all-male cleaning service to an undersexed female clientele.

Longing to return to the hills he grew to love, 11-year-old Marcel finds happiness again when his father is provided access to a footpath they can use to travel from Marseilles to Provence. Years later, Marcel purchases a castle and realizes it is the same estate his mother was terrified to cross along their journey. Based on the memoirs of French novelist, playwright and filmmaker Marcel Pagnol.

title.de: David Wants to Fly - Ein yogisches Abenteuer

overview.en: As the toast of Broadway, Cole Porter, reflects upon his life, a stage musical in the making helps capture his meteoric career and relationships.
In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is helped by a woman seeking retribution.

title.de: Dennis Rodman's Big Bang in PyongYang
title.en: Dennis Rodman's Big Bang in PyongYang

overview.en: Former NBA basketball star Dennis Rodman is on a mission. After forging an unlikely friendship with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, he wants to improve relations between North Korea and the US by staging a historic basketball game between the two countries. But the North Korean team isn’t the only opposition he’ll face. . . Condemned by the NBA and The Whitehouse, and hounded every step of the way by the press, can Dennis keep it together and make the game happen? Or will it all go up in a mushroom cloud of smoke?

In 1897 Paris, a blaze at the Bazar de la Charite kills over 100 and shatters lives. From the ashes, three women rise: an aristocrat escaping a cruel marriage, a young heiress trapped by family duty, and her maid seeking freedom. All three fight to rewrite their destinies in a society built to silence them. From Walter Presents, in French with English subtitles.
A steely two-time killer develops a growing love for birds while behind bars after finding an orphaned sparrow in the prison yard.

Two fired ad execs must take on stay-at-home dad duty when they can’t afford their kids’ pricey daycare.  Figuring a few extra kids can’t be much more work, they decide to team up and open their own daycare, with hilarious results.

overview.de: In der Hoffnung, ihre wahre Liebe unter ihren zahlreichen Ex-Freunden übersehen zu haben, begibt sich Ally auf die Suche nach dem Mr. Right unter ihnen.
overview.en: After reading a magazine article, Ally decides to track down her exes to see if one of them is 'the one' — with some help from her charming neighbor.

The story of finance whiz Martin Armstrong reads like a movie script: a man designs a model that can predict the future. He calculates developments in the world economy with eerie accuracy and even the outbreak of wars. Until the FBI is on his doorstep...
When a cruise ship capsizes after a terrorist attack, a group of survivors bands together to escape the upside-down vessel.
An elderly man struggles to cope with his wife’s death until his daughter and his estranged foster child re-enter his life, giving him new purpose.

title.de: Devil's Knot - Im Schatten der Wahrheit

overview.en: After the savage murder of three young boys, police rush to find and convict the killers, focusing on a trio of teenagers suspected of devil worship. Based on the true story of the West Memphis 3 and the murder trial that shocked the nation.
In a series of therapy sessions, residents of an unnamed city go on a psychological journey into the subconsciousness of the place they live in.

title.de: Die Beilight Saga: Breaking Wind - Bis(s) einer heult

overview.en: This raunchy, irreverent parody of the Twilight Saga is filled with vain vampires, horny werewolves, and plenty of paranormal hijinks.

title.de: Die Liebe, die heilt - Professor Moscati
title.en: St. Giuseppe Moscati: Doctor to the Poor

overview.de: Eine antike Prinzessin wird in ihrem Sarkophag unter den Sandmassen der Wüste wieder zum Leben erweckt und bringt im Verlauf der Jahrtausende gewachsene Böswilligkeit und Terror mit sich, denen die Menschen nicht gewachsen sind.
overview.en: Welcome to a new world of gods and monsters.

title.de: Die Mumie - Das Grabmal des Drachenkaisers
title.en: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor

overview.de: China 1946: Als der Drachenkaiser (Jet Li) mit seiner Armee von zehntausend unbesiegbaren Terrakotta-Kriegern nach 2.000 Jahren wieder zum Leben erweckt wird, kennt der dämonische Despot nur ein Ziel - die Weltherrschaft.
overview.en: Rick O'Connell returns to combat the resurrected Han Emperor in an epic that races from the catacombs of ancient China high into the frigid Himalayas.

overview.de: London, 1935: Zehn Jahre sind vergangen seit Abenteurer Rick O'Connell (Brendan Fraser) und Ägyptologin Evelyn Carnahan (Rachel Weisz) die rachedurstige Mumie des ägyptischen Hohepriesters Imhotep ins Jenseits beförderten. Nun braut sich wieder Unheil zusammen: Ein wilder Krieger namens Scorpion King (The Rock) kehrt aus dem Reich der Toten zurück, um mit einer gewaltigen Armee gegen die zivilisierte Welt zu Felde zu ziehen. In der Hoffnung, Imhotep könne Scorpion King Einhalt gebieten, erwecken seine skrupellosen Anhänger die Mumie zu neuem, schrecklichen Leben.
overview.en: Rick and Evelyn run afoul of more ancient Egyptian evil in this slam-bang sequel.
After landing her dream assignment planning the perfect Christmas wedding, an ad exec for a fashion magazine learns her ex is her partner on the job.

For generations, we have believed that man is driven by ruthless self-interest. But over the past decade, this idea has been increasingly challenged. New research from fields as diverse as political science, psychology, sociology and experimental economics is forcing us to rethink human actions and motivation. 'The Altruism Revolution' examines the scientific call for a more caring society.

Winner of the Queer Palm and Best Screenplay at Cannes, Hirokazu Kore-eda’s intricately structured drama delves into the fragility of boyhood. Bookended by fires and storms, delicate feelings of anger, confusion, and love swell through an exquisite final score from the late maestro Ryuichi Sakamoto.

In the stark and isolated "Central Initial Reception Office" in Eisenhüttenstadt, the lives of three asylum seekers intersect. Wasim from Syria, Mathew from Kenya, and Gedeon from Cameroon are stranded in this surreal, peripheral place, their futures uncertain as they navigate the impersonal bureaucracy of the German asylum process.
After losing his job, a married man succumbs to the temptation of a steamy affair with a wealthy art collector, leading to unexpected consequences.
Racial tensions erupt into a full-fledged war when an anti-Apartheid activist and a British engineer go on the run from South African Secret Police.
When she gets angry, middle schooler Naoko turns into fierce dinosaur Gauko! Thanks to friends, aliens and more, her life is full of wacky incidents.

Two struggling, corrupt cops set out to blackmail and frame every criminal unfortunate enough to cross their paths, until the arrival of someone who appears to be even more dangerous than them, in this hilarious and action-packed crime caper.
Filmed over the course of 10 years, The Family documents a young couples tumultuous relationship after the birth of their daughter.
A gay teen and the daughter of a prominent Jehovah's Witness elder embark on an intense affair that will force them to choose between faith and love.

Actor, Comedian, Superstar. Eddie Murphy is the epitome of raw comic success, creating a roar of laughter when on stage or screen. Arguably, he is the preeminent black comic of his era and at his peak ,no other performer was a bigger star.

Every year, an ambitious young woman uses the weeks leading up to Christmas to become the ultimate holiday freelance assistant for hire, helping with any Christmas related tasks for extra income. But when the opportunity arrives to save a Christmas party and dazzle her crush, she must choose between the man of her aspirations and Mr. Right.
A college student kills his rich girlfriend, then charms her sister who does not know who he is.
After a botched robbery, two thieves choose as their hideout an isolated farmhouse occupied by a family with a raft of their own internal conflicts.

It's been ten years since the Black Plague ravaged the lands. A poor family sets out on a journey to find a better place to live. On a desolate mountain pass, the family is attacked by a pack of merciless killers. The only one to be spared is 19 year old Signe, who is taken hostage and brought back to camp.
A spoof of teen sex romps in which high school students with hormones in overdrive fumble their way through a humiliating series of sexual exploits.
A serial killer hides in plain sight while closing in on his sole survivor whose head injury during her attack makes her unable to identify him.
Kathy gets an unexpected lesson in the value of true friendship as competition quickly heats up at equestrian camp with the resident mean girl.

overview.de: Eine Gruppe jugendlicher Schulfreunde ist glücklicherweise knapp einer tödlichen Flugzeugexplosion entkommen. Aber der Tod lässt sich nicht so einfach überlisten.
overview.en: Teens meet with horrible ends after a classmate's (Devon Sawa) precognitive vision leads to their ejection from a doomed airliner.

overview.de: Eine Schülerin sieht im Traum eine Massenkarambolage voraus und rettet vielen Menschen das Leben. Doch auch in Teil 2 des Kultschockers lässt sich der Tod nicht ins Handwerk pfuschen.
overview.en: A college freshman has a premonition of a horrible car accident, which she thwarts. But Death will not be cheated, and those who escaped their fate struggle to stay alive.

overview.de: Wendy feiert ihren Highschool-Abschluss im Freizeitpark und hat eine Vorahnung eines tödlichen Unfalls, dem sie und einige Freunde entkommen. Doch der Tod lässt nicht locker, und sie versuchen, Hinweise aus Fotos zu deuten, um zu überleben.
overview.en: Death makes a bloody date with a group of unlucky teens who escaped a fatal roller-coaster crash in this harrowing horror sequel.

overview.de: Am McKinley Speedway gelingt es Nick O'Bannon (Bobby Campo) durch eine schreckliche Vision, mehreren Menschen das Leben zu retten. Doch wenig später rächt sich der Tod auf bestialische Weise.
overview.en: Horrible fates await friends who narrowly escaped death during a horrific racecar crash.

overview.de: Der Tod kehrt für eine weitere wilde Fahrt im neusten „Final Destination 5“ zurück. Mit den ursprünglichen Produzenten der Serie an Bord, einem Drehbuch des gefeierten Autors von „Nightmare on Elm Street“ [2010] und dem mit Spannung erwarteten Remake von „The Thing“ … und James Camerons Schützling Steven Quale hinter der Kamera (wie schon bei „Avatar“ und „Titanic“) knüpft diese neueste tödliche Bustour des Grauens an Teil 4 an, der an den Kinokassen weltweit rund 200 Mio. US-Dollar einspielte. Mit einer Besetzung, zu der Nick D'Agosto aus „Heroes“, Emma Bell aus „The Walking Dead“, Arlen Escarpeta aus „Freitag der 13.“, David Koechner aus „The Office“ und Tony Todd aus „Candyman“ (Urgestein der „Destination“-Reihe) gehören, dürfte der Sensenmann angesichts lebensgefährlicher 3D-Sequenzen wie dem Einsturz einer Hängebrücke, einer misslungenen Laser-Augen-OP und anderen teuflisch cleveren Todesarten auf seine Kosten kommen!
overview.en: Survivors of a bridge disaster learn that they cannot cheat Death.
The life cycle and uniquely long annual migration of North America's monarch butterfly is examined in this nature documentary.

For Nina and Ben, the idyllic island of Formentera seems to be the perfect holiday paradise. Their sun-drenched escape, however, takes a dark and mysterious turn when a young woman suddenly vanishes. The disappearance shatters the tranquil atmosphere, plunging them into a world of uncertainty and suspicion under the Mediterranean sun.
What is the Mandelbrot set and fractal geometry and how has it impacted computer technology? This educational documentary seeks answers.
Daughter of the manor Julie breaks off her engagement only to fall for one of her staff. A romance that begins innocently ends in a tragedy
Tres personas son transportadas a una realidad paralela donde deberán utilizar tecnología moderna y armas medievales para detener a un tirano.
Told by journalists, celebrities, fans, and developers, this film is a nostalgic celebration of one of the most important video games of all time.
When he starts at a new school, an illiterate young boy fights to improve academically and slowly begins to believe in a different future for himself.

In the mythical Swedish town of Ydre, where giants once roamed, the idealistic mayor cherishes every new birth. This cinematic tale blends creation myths with everyday life, humorously exploring community life, responsibility, and the simple, profound moments that connect generations in this tiny, magical place.

overview.de: Harry Burns (Billy Crystal) und Sally Albright (Meg Ryan) bilden eine Fahrgemeinschaft von Chicago nach New York. Unterwegs streiten sie über die Frage, ob Frauen und Männer nur Freunde sein können. Auch später laufen sich die beiden immer wieder über den Weg, scheitern in unterschiedlichen Beziehungen, bis eine enge Freundschaft zwischen ihnen aufblüht. Doch eine Antwort auf die Frage "Können ein Mann und eine Frau Freunde sein, ohne dass ihnen der Gedanke an Sex im Weg steht?" haben sie immer noch nicht gefunden.
overview.en: College graduates Harry and Sally meet on a road trip and later become friends, debating whether men and women can truly be platonic. As their bond deepens over the years, they navigate love, friendship, and the possibility of romance.
As modernity threatens one of the last brickyards in Hellegat, young worker Sam bonds with 65-year-old Louis over work, soccer and pigeon fancying.
Duty and uncertainty take a toll on two sailors working a cargo ship with an unknown mission — and date of departure. Based on the novel by Ivo Michiels.
In this historical drama, a downtrodden farmer and his children struggle with inequality, exploitation and the machinations of wealthy aristocrats.

Three British women from traditional Muslim backgrounds find love outside their faith, forcing them to confront a deeply personal conflict. Their stories intimately explore the struggle to reconcile modern love with deeply ingrained traditions, facing the fear of ostracism while navigating the tensions between cultural integration and heritage in contemporary society.

title.en: Hieronymus Bosch: Touched by the Devil

title.de: High Voltage - Vergebung ist keine Option
How to Re-Establish a Vodka Empire
title.en: How to Re-Establish a Vodka Empire

overview.en: Dan Edelstyn explores his Jewish Ukrainian roots and revives his grandfather's vodka business .

title.de: Hubert Butler Witness to the Future
title.en: Hubert Butler Witness to the Future

overview.en: This documentary explores the life of the Irish essayist and human rights champion who helped smuggle Jewish people to Ireland before World War II.
How much ownership can we have over our thoughts? This documentary speaks to political theorists, activists, philosophers, and more.
An annual reunion for a group of college buddies, now in their forties, spirals out of control as each man unravels for his own personal reasons.
The high-octane story of the 2011 British superbike season, culminating in an exhilarating final race between the six top contenders.

title.de: I, Superbiker 3 - The Day Of Reckoning
title.en: I, Superbiker 3 - The Day Of Reckoning

overview.en: With competitors in hot pursuit, reigning superbike champ Tommy Hill defends his crown in a turbo-charged showdown to close the season in first place.

title.de: I, Superbiker: The War for Four
title.en: I, Superbiker: The War for Four

overview.en: Broadcasting legend Murray Walker narrates this action-filled racing film that captures all the fantastic spectacle that is British superbikes.

title.de: Ice Age 3 - Die Dinosaurier sind los
title.en: Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs

overview.de: After Sid pilfers some dinosaur eggs, Manny, Diego and the rest of their prehistoric pals enter a mysterious, underground world to rescue the hapless sloth. During the course of their mission, the gang encounters many creatures great and small, including hungry carnivores and a relentless, dinosaur-hunting weasel named Buck.
overview.en: The sub-zero heroes from Ice Age are back on an a new incredible adventure. Scrat is still trying to nab the ever-elusive nut (while, maybe, finding true love); Manny and Ellie await the birth of their mini-mammoth; Diego wonders if he is going too soft hanging with his pals and Sid gets into trouble when he creates his own makeshift family by hijacking some dinosaur eggs.On a mission to re...

title.de: ICON(S): Maison Francis Kurkdjian, The alchemy of senses
title.en: ICON(S): Maison Francis Kurkdjian, The alchemy of senses

overview.en: A successful stand-up comic has to push himself through a grueling group comedy tour while suffering a crisis of confidence.
Born into privilege, a rebellious teenager longs for a life far from his schizophrenic father, self-absorbed mother, and conservative big brother.

title.de: John Lennon: Love Is All You Need
title.en: John Lennon: Love Is All You Need

overview.en: Rare footage and in-depth interviews with his wives, his son Julian and Lennon himself capture his rise to stardom and as an advocate for world peace.

Jeremy Sisto stars as the ill-fated Roman lead who conquered much of the known world in the name of his empire, leading him to be named dictator for life and later assassinated by his nephew and trusted ally, Marcus Brutus (Paolo Briguglia). Also starring Richard Harris, Valeria Golino, and Christopher Walken, Julius Caesar has also been aired under the simplified title of Caesar.

John J. is a seasoned hit man sent on a job to Argentina. When the General he's sent to kill delays his return to the country, John passes the time with Manuela, a beautiful dancer who becomes his teacher and guide into Argentina's sensual world of the tango. Spellbound by the rich and mysterious world Manuela has shown him, his idyll is shattered when the reality of why he's there comes crashing down around him.

title.de: King George VI: The Man Behind the King's Speech
title.en: King George VI: The Man Behind the King's Speech

overview.en: Following his brother's sudden abdication, a reluctant new king must overcome his failings and a stutter to unite his nation during turbulent times.

The planet’s largest oil companies were among the first to detect global warming. Unsurprisingly, instead of taking action, they launched a campaign which, for thirty years, has derailed the fight against climate change. A shocking investigation uncovers what was done to impede the battle against climate change, and who was behind it. Company scientists were fired, public perception was manipulated – as the scale and urgency of the climate crisis is becoming undeniably clear, the impact that these actions may have had on the race to save the planet are more shocking than ever.
MMA fighters Ismail Cetinkaya, Kamil Lipski and Carlos Eduardo Rocha navigate injury, defeat and emotional growth in this intimate documentary.
Kobe, a young, successful writer with fame and love, struggles to escape a hidden past that still haunts his present life.
A family reunites to discuss the selling of their beloved house, but their secrets threaten to overwhelm them as they come to light.
Set against the rural backdrop of small-town Arkansas, two high school sweethearts imagine their futures apart as one prepares to leave for college.

title.de: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Maximale Superkräfte
title.en: LEGO MARVEL Super Heroes: Maximum Overload

overview.en: Kids animation. Loki is causing trouble once again, and this time he's using a massive snowball to give supervillains a freezing edge. Can anyone stop him?

title.de: LEGO Marvel Superhelden - Avengers neu montiert!
title.en: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled!

overview.en: The Avengers are forced to “party” with Ultron when he seeks to disassemble the team and take over the world by hijacking Iron Man's armor.
In post-Katrina New Orleans, a disgraced detective gets a second chance when the ghost of a murdered woman wants to help him identify her killer.
This documentary presents the ultimate untold story of the Glastonbury Festival and the man who spearheaded the movement behind its influence.

In this thriller, D.A. Dana Greenway goes undercover to pursue a predator who impersonates a famous photographer to exploit women. But the hunter soon becomes the hunted in a dangerous game that blurs the lines between justice and vengeance.

title.de: Love is Love? - Wenn deine Liebe verboten ist

overview.en: An opera company rehearsing Donizetti's tragic play 'Lucia Di Lammermoor' start to see parallels in their lives to those of the characters.

Deep inside the most secure bank in America, three desperate women from very different worlds cook up the most unlikely heist of the century: Smuggle out millions of dollars in worn-out currency headed for a Federal Reserve shredder every day.
This documentary explores the challenges facing wild horses around the world and the efforts being made to preserve their existence.
Tough young Mally gathers seaweed on the Cornish coast to make ends meet. When a local boy invades her beach, she fears her livelihood is in jeopardy.
Using archival footage and expert interviews, this documentary examines the career of orchestral conductor Mantovani and his famous "cascading strings."

title.de: Manufacturing Death: Birth of the Atom Bomb
title.en: Manufacturing Death: Birth of the Atom Bomb

overview.en: How the advent of nuclear weapons brought an end to the biggest conflict in history and ushered in an atomic age and a defining era of Big Science.
This documentary shows the humble roots of a young girl who would one day become Britain's Prime Minister, having a lasting impact on world history.

overview.de: Maria Callas wird als die größte Opernsängerin ihrer Zeit bezeichnet. „Maria“ erzählt nun erstmals die Geschichte der Diva durch ihre eigenen Augen, als sie ihr turbulentes, schönes und tragisches Leben kurz vor ihrem Tod 1979 in Paris noch einmal durchlebt. „Maria“ ist der Abschluss von Pablo Larraíns Trilogie über faszinierende und berühmte Frauen des 20. Jahrhunderts, die er mit „Jackie“ und „Spencer“ begonnen hat.
overview.en: Showstopping. Mesmerizing. Uncompromising. Oscar winner Angelina Jolie stars as opera legend Maria Callas in this moving drama of the diva's final days.
After a brain hemorrhage, a boxing champ fights the system to get back in the ring.
An escaped prisoner takes a little boy hostage, but the boy quickly becomes dazzled by his captor’s swagger and defiance. Soon the two are teaming up to make life rough for the authorities!
After Max is adopted by his late handler's family, a shocking story begins to unravel.

title.en: You Will Not Have My Hate

overview.en:
Antoine lost his wife in the Bataclan bombing in Paris. In a Facebook post, he explains how he resists hate: he opposes that of terrorists to his love for his 3-year-old son. Bereaved, he seems to be losing ground.

Some flashing lights sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.
While pursued by a U.S. rival, a greedy Polish mercenary aids a mine worker and peasant girl as they lead a revolution against the Mexican government.

Memo is a shepherd with a mental deficiency but he lives happily in his small world. In 1983, when Memo is framed with the murder of the martial law commander's daughter, his life is turned upside down. He's sentenced to death and gets locked up in ward seven...
The true story of one boy's journey as a victim of Nazi oppression, and how his love of art and music helped him endure the atrocities of the Holocaust.
The story of Beatrix Potter, the author of the beloved and best-selling children's book, "The Tale of Peter Rabbit", and her struggle for love, happiness and success.

title.de: Mistletoe Ranch - Wo das Herz wohnt

overview.en: Aimée is a budding photographer, following her boss around the world.
