When she receives a mailbag full of letters informing her that her late mother's famous Christmas Celebration has been cancelled, she makes her way back to Mistletoe Ranch to save the family tradition. Once there, she reconnects with her ex-fiancé and Aimée discovers that the key to her heart was right where she left it.

overview.de: Als Frontmann der polnischen Rockband Lady Pank prägt Jan Borysewicz mit seiner Musik eine gesamte Generation – und erleidet selbst einige Familientragödien.
overview.en: As the leader of Polish rock band Lady Pank, Jan Borysewicz shapes a generation with his music — while a string of family tragedies shapes him.
A closer look at the ubiquity of the world's most common plastic chair as a microcosm of globalization, aesthetic judgment and economic inequality.
After losing his job as an engineer at the auto manufacturing plant, a man tries to come to terms with his new identity as a house husband.

title.de: My Christmas Family Tree - Mein Weihnachts-Stammbaum

overview.en: When Vanessa receives the results from her Family Tree DNA test, she discovers a family she didn't know existed and travels to their home for Christmas.[W Network]
After a female activist protesting the death penalty befriends a woman with opposing views, they begin a relationship that tests their beliefs.

overview.de: Marie und Luis lernen sich auf einer Party kennen und verfallen einander sofort. Was als Traum von der großen Liebe beginnt, entspinnt sich immer mehr zum Albtraum. Denn: Luis ist süchtig nach Sex. Und Marie süchtig nach Luis. (ARD Serie)
overview.en: Marie und Luis lernen sich auf einer Party kennen und verfallen einander sofort. Was als Traum von der großen Liebe beginnt, entspinnt sich immer mehr zum Albtraum. Denn: Luis ist süchtig nach Sex. Und Marie süchtig nach Luis. (ARD Serie)
One day in the life of three seamstresses, each of whom is hiding a dark and troubling secret.
A wrench is thrown into a small-time dealer’s plan to go straight when one last drug deal with cash borrowed from a dangerous loan shark goes wrong.

A lavish history of Iran's extraordinary art from 1785 to 1925. While offering an overview of painters and paintings of the period and its continued legacy, it weaves together art history and Persian history.
On the hottest day in 50 years, a serious fire incident happened to a busy commercial tower, a gaggle of fire fighters with an indestructible enthusiasm are going to save lives...
To fulfill his wife’s last wishes, a trucker pulls his estranged son out of military school to compete in an arm wrestling championship in Vegas.
A widower develops a new appreciation for life after moving to the countryside, but his pastoral life is threatened when developers target his valley.
The death of an old woman in a Moldovan village leads to a meditation on life, loss and longing as people gather to say goodbye.
Set in 1990s Algeria, an aspiring young clothing designer pushes back against conservative policies by putting on a fashion show at her university.
Experience the horrors of trench warfare through the eyes of a young Dutch soldier as he volunteers to fight the German army in the First World War.

Set at Pensacola's Naval Air Station, "Pensacola: Wings of Gold" follows Col. Bill Kelly who is the new commander of four young officers selected to form an elite military task force. But complicating the Colonel's task is his relationship with his young daughter and one of his officer's romantic interest in her. The colonel himself must also accept his own interest in an civilian doctor.
A Holocaust survivor receives surgery to repair her disfigured face before searching for her husband who may have betrayed her to the Nazis.

title.de: Pietje Bell 2: De Jacht op de Tsarenkroon
title.en: Peter Bell II: The Hunt for the Czar Crown

overview.en: Rascally Pietje and his Black Hand gang tangle with villain Stark as he and two cronies scheme to steal a priceless royal crown.

For decades, Theo Jansen has toiled on the beaches of the Netherlands in his quest to make his beloved Strandbeests self-sufficient. But what happens when, as the artist pursues his dream to create new life, he starts to feel his own slipping away? As he contemplates whether he is the Strandbeests' master or slave, Theo races against the inevitable passing of time and his eventual death.
Cable guys in Eastern Europe connect a dissonant world with lots of humor and philosophy.

title.de: Police Epidemy - Die Bullen sind los

overview.en: Two bumbling cops receive three ransom notes for one missing woman in a case that turns out to be much more complicated than it seems.

title.de: Princes of the Palace - The Royal British Family
title.en: Princes of the Palace - The Royal British Family

overview.en: Explore the unique personalities and fascinating lives of the princes of the British Royal Family in this chronicle that spans the generations.

When popular Stockholm priest Henrik learns of his father's death from a drowning accident, he travels through the dark, endless forests to reach the desolate village in order to investigate the mysterious death. However, his arrival at the village begins to set dark forces into motion, opening a door to the other side where ghosts from the past begin to cross over into the real world. And the ghosts seem to have one single purpose... Vengeance. Suspenseful, thrilling and darkly creepy, PSALM 21 is a terrifying journey from the very gates of hell.
With rare performances and interviews, this punchy documentary chronicles how punk collapsed into ska, new wave, and the mod scene in the late ‘70s.
A chronicle of the British punk explosion of the late 1970s, featuring early live performances by iconic bands and interviews with those on the scene.
An unapologetic look at mud-racing and the culture surrounding it, as one enthusiast questions his life, and the last mudhole in Orlando is shut down.

title.en: Redemption: The Stan Tookie Williams Story

overview.en: The young, gifted and black generation of the 70's who started the British Reggae movement is captured in this unique documentary. Groove to the smooth sounds and see rare footage
A widowed young aristocrat falls in love with a woman who nursed him in the Great War and tries to marry her against his family’s wishes.
A perennially single dating coach attempts to seduce a prince as she helps him navigate the cut-throat NYC dating scene.
A reality -TV star leaves Hollywood and finds herself in Amish country where she must decide between her newfound reality or returning to fame.
Compelling drama based on the real experinces of journalist Richard Boyle in strife-ridden El Salvador in 1980-81.
Olivia Pope goes from White House fixer to protecting the who’s who of the Washington, D.C. elite when she launches her own crisis management firm.

overview.de: Sieben freiwillige Testkandidaten nehmen an einem Experiment für ein neues Medikament teil. Schon bald findet keiner der Probanden mehr in den Schlaf, doch mit dem Ende des Experiments kehrt schließlich auch die Müdigkeit zurück und erweist sich als tödliche Konsequenz: Sobald jemand einschläft, stirbt er. Der Kampf ums Überleben beginnt...
overview.en: Trapped in a facility after an experimental drug trial horribly goes awry, test subjects must fight off sleep—and each other—to stay alive.

The extinction of the Aral Sea is one of the most disastrous human-caused catastrophes in the world history. Rusty skeletons of ships and deserts of salt fall below the horizon, which once was covered by the marine waves - all these images come to mind when you think of The Aral, the world after the end.
This documentary follows the two co-founders of Take Me Back, a charity that delivers school supplies to children in remote areas of Sri Lanka.
Mason is a matchmaking with a booming success rate and is an expert on relationships. When it comes to love, he knows all, except how to hold onto his husband.
This documentary presents these underwater apex predators not as monsters that kill for sport, but as intelligent and cautious creatures with a bad rap.
Straight after her marriage, Hong Kong officer Mina Kao faces a dangerous case of vietnamese criminal refugees.

An ex-con gets released early from prison only to be forced into an undercover unit of six men and on his first day the other five are all killed. Now he must face the men who he was tasked to spy on.

title.en: General Mayhem: The Killing of Brigadier J

overview.de: Seit Michaels Freundin verschwunden ist, steht sein Leben still. Ein geheimnisvolles Rezept in einem alten Tagebuch könnte neue Hoffnung bringen.
overview.en: Since his girlfriend went missing seven years ago Michael Sleep's life has been on hold.  But a mystical recipe in an old journal promises to give the answers he's been longing for.
A tech-savvy nine-year-old ends up in Santa’s workshop on Christmas Eve and decides to help the elves modernize their old-fashioned production line.

title.de: Solar System: The Secrets of the Universe
title.en: Solar System: The Secrets of the Universe

overview.en: Journey to the year 2050 aboard the International Space Station and marvel at the three-dimensional sights and astral bodies that surround us.

When an invading alien race drives humanity to the brink of extinction, the crew of an advanced interstellar ship embarks on a grueling mission to retrieve technology from a distant planet to save Earth.

overview.de: Seit einer schweren Erkrankung in ihrer Jugend ist Maddie taubstumm. Davon hat sie sich aber nie entmutigen lassen und konnte als Roman-Autorin Karriere machen. Nachdem ihr Erstling zum Bestseller avancierte, schreibt sie gerade am Abschluss ihres zweiten Romans. Schon bald hat sie viel größere Probleme, als ein passendes Finale für ihre Geschichte zu finden, als ein maskierter Mann vor ihrem Fenster steht. Dieser beginnt ein perfides Katz- und Maus-Spiel an dessen Ende der Tod von Maddie stehen soll. Doch die alleinstehende Frau ist wesentlich wehrhafter, als der Psychopath erwartet hätte.
overview.en: A deaf and mute writer living in the woods must fight for her life in silence when a terrifying masked killer appears at her window.
Traumatized soldiers find healing for their inner wounds through innovative horse therapy.

overview.de: Die Welt am Abgrund: der diabolische Diktator General Bison (Raul Julia) terrorisiert mit seiner gewalttätigen Streitmacht das Land. Über 60 UN-Mitarbeiter hat er bereits als Geiseln, verlangt 20 Milliarden Dollar Lösegeld, der gefährliche Konflikt steht an der Schwelle eines Weltkrieges. Da tritt der Oberbefehlshaber der Alliierten Truppen, Colonel Guile (Jean-Claude Van Damme) mit seiner Elit..
overview.en: Jean-Claude Van Damme leads this box-office smash, adapted from the videogame, about a commando and his street fighters out to stop an evil general.
A team of scientists must act quickly to prevent the sun from exploding and creating a supernova, which would engulf the earth in an armageddon of flames.
T R Y holds a mirror to reality, reflecting on friendship, maturity, and finding oneself.

Inspired by real events. One man travels to an unfamiliar country with hopes of becoming a professional fighter. Upon his arrival, he runs into a series of unfortunate events which leave him broke with no place to stay. He stumbles upon a rugged Muay Thai boxing camp that allows him to train and fight. Through his fights in and outside of the ring, his talent and skill will get him his biggest fight yet, against the world champion _ a contest that will leave only one man a winner in the ring.

title.de: The Artist and the Wall of Death
title.en: The Artist and the Wall of Death

overview.en: Glaswegian visual artist, Stephen Skrynka, has been fascinated with the 'wall of death' all his life. He dreams of transforming the traditional fairground motorbike attraction into an art form. But after a devastating fallout with his collaborators, Stephen decides to hand-build his own wall. A story of embracing failure and the relentless determination of an artist to realise his dream.
This documentary explores the history of nuclear energy through the eyes of engineers, politicians and advocates on both sides of the debate.

In the small border town of La Joya, Texas, police officers patrol the neighborhood looking for human smugglers. But rather than arresting the immigrants, the officers are gathering intelligence on the smuggling gangs tied to Mexican cartels. Slowly the mutual dependence between police and smuggler reveals a system caught in a never-ending cycle, with the immigrant dangerously caught in between.
As the wealth gap widens in the modern world, seven people striving for a better life discover the odds may be stacked against them.
“Snowfall” characters Wanda and Leon chase reinvention in ’90s L.A. as West Coast rap rises.

title.de: The Eagles - Himmel und Hölle Kaliforniens

overview.en: Director Alison Ellwood, along with Producer Alex Gibney, meticulously crafts an intimate patchwork of rare archival material, concert footage, and unseen home movies exploring the evolution and enduring popularity of one of America's truly definitive bands, The Eagles.

Tara is a housewife in suburban London who's raising two young children while married to an overworked, self-absorbed husband. In desperate need of a change, Tara makes the bold decision to leave everything behind and buy a one-way ticket to Paris. Her newfound freedom and journey of self-discovery soon gives way to the realization that walking out on your life isn't so simple.
The fourth film in the Purge series depicts the launch of a program that legalizes violence for a single terrifying night.

overview.de: Dakota Johnson und Casey Affleck kommen als Elternpaar nach einer Krebsdiagnose nicht mehr mit dem Alltag klar - bis ihr Freund (Jason Segel) bei ihnen einzieht. Drama nach wahrer Geschichte.
overview.en: A couple's life is turned upside down by a terminal cancer diagnosis, and they find support in their best friend, who puts his life on hold to help.
In this Covid-era Italian thriller, Roxanne, a cold middle-aged pipe organ restorer, battles to suppress her obsessive attraction to her new young and mute assistant.

title.de: The High Frontier: The Untold Story of Gerard K. O'Neill
title.en: The High Frontier: The Untold Story of Gerard K. O'Neill

overview.en: This documentary tells the story of physicist Gerard K. O’Neill, whose visionary research sparked a grassroots movement to colonize outer space.

Combat is part of life. The talented members of Team KOTOBUKI use their impressive aerial fighting skills to help defend and transport goods across a desolate wasteland. For the right price, they’ll take on any enemy that comes their way!

title.de: The Prosecutor, the Defender, the Father and his Son
title.en: The Prosecutor, the Defender, the Father and his Son

overview.en: Two ambitious lawyers face off in the tense Hague trial of a commander accused of committing war crimes in the Bosnian War. Inspired by true events.

overview.de: Survival-Thriller: Es ist wieder "Säuberung". Eine Nacht lang sind alle Verbrechen erlaubt. Fünf Menschen kämpfen sich durch die mörderischen Horden.
overview.en: One night per year, the government sanctions a 12-hour period in which citizens can commit any crime they wish -- including murder -- without fear of punishment or imprisonment. Leo, a sergeant who lost his son, plans a vigilante mission of revenge during the mayhem. However, instead of a death-dealing avenger, he becomes the unexpected protector of four innocent strangers who desperately need his help if they are to survive the night.

overview.de: Amerika ist im Ausnahmezustand - und Frank Grillo und Elizabeth Mitchell sind mittendrin: Die Purge-Nacht steht bevor; die Nacht, in der für 12 Stunden alle Verbrechen legal sind.
overview.en: Leo Barnes is now the main bodyguard for Senator Charlie Roan, who plans to end the Purge forever. But in one last night of anarchy, a betrayal forces them out onto the streets, where Ms. Roan is the most coveted target.

title.en: Mark Felt: The Man Who Brought Down the White House

overview.en: Based on a true story of the most famous anonymous man in American history: Mark Felt, the FBI second-in command who was the "Deep Throat" whistleblower in the 1970s Watergate scandal.
When an English lawyer teams up with his friend and an American computer expert, they steal back stolen money from a multinational company.

title.de: The Wanderers - Terror in der Bronx

overview.en: The Wanderers are a teenage gang who are growing up and coming to terms with life in the city.

Hilarious cult sitcom series which takes the mockumentary format to explore the lives of young people in modern rural Britain, focusing on cousins Kerry and Lee 'Kurtan' Mucklowe and their life experiences in their typical Cotswold village.
An Assistant D.A. working on a murder case uncovers a trail of corruption.

title.de: Touch the Sound - A Sound Journey with Evelyn Glennie

overview.en: A nearly deaf percussionist explores the deep connections between sound, rhythm, and body.

title.de: Two Moon Junction - Fesseln der Leidenschaft

overview.en: A beautiful southern debutante is about to marry a man just as privileged as she. But when she locks eyes with a rough-hewn, sensual carnival worker, she is drawn into an erotically charged battle of wills that will change her life forever.

FBI meets DEA when two cocky agents (Dylan Sprouse, Mason Gooding) discover they've been working the same case - on opposite sides. Trapped by a sniper and surrounded by bodies, they must unite or die trying.

overview.de: Ein zufälliges Treffen bringt eine Ex-Polizistin in Kontakt mit ihrem ehemaligen Freund, einem New Yorker Polizisten, der sie überredet, ihr außergewöhnliches Gedächtnis zur Aufklärung von Verbrechen einzusetzen.
overview.en: Carrie Wells is a former NY Police detective who has a rare medical condition that gives her the ability to visually remember everything. She rejoins the force and uses her ability to solve crimes.
In the Belgian hamlet of Verbrande Brug, former lovers Monique and Louis reconnect at a carnival, stirring up drama with their current partners.
A teenage girl runs away after a fight with her father, sparking a major police investigation.

overview.de: Eine Stunde noch, dann neigt sich auch diese Nacht in Berlin wieder dem Ende zu. Vor einem Club lernt Victoria (Laia Costa), eine junge Frau aus Madrid, vier Berliner Jungs kennen – Sonne (Frederick Lau), Boxer (Franz Rogowski), Blinker (Burak Yigit) und Fuß (Max Mauff). Der Funke zwischen ihr und Sonne springt sofort über, aber Zeit füreinander haben die beiden nicht. Sonne und seine Kumpels haben noch etwas vor. Um eine Schuld zu begleichen, haben sie sich auf eine krumme Sache eingelassen. Als einer von ihnen unerwartet ausfällt, soll Victoria als Fahrerin einspringen. Was für sie wie ein großes Abenteuer beginnt, entwickelt sich zunächst zu einem verrückten euphorischen Tanz – und dann schnell zum Albtraum. Während der Tag langsam anbricht, geht es für Victoria und Sonne auf einmal um Alles oder Nichts...
overview.en: Berlin, 4am. Victoria, a young woman from Madrid, meets Sonne and his three mates outside a club. The local guys promise to show Victoria the real side of the city, but they owe someone a dangerous favour that requires repaying that evening. As Victoria's flirtation with Sonne deepens into something more he convinces her to come along for the ride. And as the night takes on an ever more menacing c
A wounded outlaw nursed back to health by three impressionable farm boys teaches them his trade and then enlists them in his bank robberies.

For 45 years East Germany was ruled by a strict communist government, on the geographical edge but political heart of the Soviet bloc. In 1987, a British film crew gained unprecedented access to film everyday life inside the GDR - but only the side of life the state let them see. In this doc the crew return to the places and people they visited then, to see how their lives have changed.
In this adaptation of John Steinbeck's classic novel, a migrant worker looks after his dimwitted, gentle-giant friend during the Great Depression.
Nick returns home after his sheriff father’s death in a suspicious car accident and is left with no choice but to take justice into his own hands.
An unemployed Italian bricklayer struggles to get his family through a harsh Colorado winter in 1925 by doing odd jobs for a wealthy local widow.

Though Azzedine is a Paralympic champion at home in Morocco, he is an outcast. Denied a salary or social care - even the right to train in the city stadium - Azzedine and his friend Yousef prepare for the next Paralympic Games in Rio. Returning after a golden performance, Azzedine hopes for a hero's welcome, but instead he must fight for his basic human rights.

overview.de: Er war ein begnadeter Comedian – doch sein wahres Genie lag woanders. Diese starbesetzte Doku beleuchtet Martin Mulls lebenslange, große Leidenschaft für die Kunst.
overview.en: He was a world-class comedian — and that's not even what he did best. Discover Martin Mull's lifelong artistic passion in this star-studded documentary.
Based on the best-selling novel by Karen Kingsbury. When biological parents try to get their child back, a man and his wife must fight to retain custody of their adopted son.

overview.de: Familie Alexander zieht in ein neues Zuhause. Dort stellt Tochter Hannah fest, dass etwas nicht mit rechten Dingen zugeht und macht eine schreckliche Entdeckung.
overview.en: A family moves into a new home, but as strange things begin to happen around them, it becomes clear that something about it isn't right.
A gay party boy faces a twist when his straight, pregnant best friend shows up asking him to pretend to be the father to her child.
When a drug deal goes wrong, utter mayhem links the fate of three gangs, an unscrupulous cop, a greedy monster, and a street-smart stringer.
A police detective's personal life crumbles as he and his colleague investigate a powerful entrepreneur's shady dealings in Antwerp's nightlife.

7-year-old Aya spends a lot of time in the theater where her father, Asen, is an actor. One night at the end of the show, intrigue, betrayal and tension in the company gradually escalate. Asen’s illusions collapse when he finds out that television star Boyan will replace him. Will Asen succeed to rediscover himself with the unreserved support of his wife and the selfless love of his daughter?
A prison psychologist in Kazichene, Bulgaria, uses unconventional methods to bring out the best in the inmates under his care.
Half-sisters Iva and Maya must grow up quickly when their father Andrey falls into a coma and their world turns upside down.
After disappearing for two days, 12-year-old Radostin returns home with two menacing-looking friends and a rebellious new attitude.
In this documentary, discover the historical roots of deep-seated socio-political division in Montenegro and uncover who was profiting from them.
Four strangers' lives intersect over three decades as they confront grief and hope after the 1995 Kobe and 2011 Tohoku quakes and the COVID-19 pandemic.

title.de: Der letzte Exorzismus - The Next Chapter

overview.de: Als einzige Überlebende des grauenvollen Exorzismus-Rituals ist Nell Sweezer noch immer tief traumatisiert. Die Ereignisse der letzten Monate scheinen komplett aus ihrem Gedächtnis gelöscht und doch weiß sie, dass etwas abgrundtief Böses von ihr Besitz ergriffen hat. Geplagt von schrecklichen Albträumen versucht Nell ein neues Leben zu starten und tatsächlich findet sie bald neue Freunde. Bis die Vergangenheut sie mit ungemeiner Kraft wieder einholt. Das Böse schreibt ein neues Kapitel. In der direkten Fortsetzung des Überraschungs-Hits „Der letzte Exorzismus“ beschwört das Dunkle die Hölle auf Erden. Produziert von Horror-Ikone Eli Roth („Cabin Fever“, „Hostel“)
overview.en: A demonic force returns with evil plans for Nell Sweetzer (Ashley Bell).

overview.de: Der Mars im Jahre 2176. Mehr als 640.000 Menschen haben die überbevölkerte Erde verlassen und leben mittlerweile in versprengten Siedlungen auf dem roten Planeten. Dort werden in unzähligen Minen die wertvollen Bodenschätze abgetragen. Doch in Shining Canyon ereignet sich bei einer dieser Operationen ein verheerender Zwischenfall: Eine lange verschwundene Ur-Zivilisation des Mars wird zu neuem ..
overview.en: Natasha Henstridge, Jason Statham, Pam Grier and Ice Cube must battle it out against primitive Martian ghosts who will stop at nothing to annihilate the human invaders who have disturbed their planet.
Keiji is more than just an ordinary rooster - he’s humanity’s greatest defender!

overview.de: "Man kann niemals zu reich sein … oder zu lustig. Komiker Damon Wayans (Fernsehserie ""In Living Color"", The Last Boy Scout - Das Ziel ist Überleben) bringt seine übel gesinnte Galerie von unerhörten Charakteren in diese actionreiche Komödie über einen Trickbetrüger, der versucht sich zu bessern, aber immer wieder in die falsche Richtung gezogen wird."
overview.en: A con artist tries to go straight in a credit card company’s mailroom, but mounting debts tempt him back to schemes to impress an ambitious assistant.

overview.de: Matthew Modine spielt die Hauptrolle als Highschool-Ringer, der versucht, viel zu schnell 23 Pfund zu verlieren, um es mit dem unbesiegten Meister der 168-Pfund-Klasse aufzunehmen.
overview.en: A gentle but driven 18-year-old underdog toils against the odds to become Washington state’s top wrestler while winning the heart of a young drifter.

overview.de: Marijuana is the flavor of the day when America's favorite burnouts sell their "goodies" from an ice-cream truck.
overview.en: In this wacky comedy, stoners Cheech and Chong are disguised as ice cream vendors, and make - and lose - millions of dollars by selling a batch of specially mixed ice cream.

overview.de: Was als einfache Abstimmung über einen neuen Grill im Tennisclub beginnt, eskaliert zum hitzigen Streit über Religion, Identität und Toleranz. Der Vorschlag, für das einzige türkische Mitglied einen eigenen Grill zu kaufen, lässt Atheisten, Gläubige, Deutsche und Türken frontal aufeinanderprallen - respektlos, pointiert und urkomisch. Schnell wird klar: Es geht um viel mehr als nur um einen Grill…
overview.en: Was als einfache Abstimmung über einen neuen Grill im Tennisclub beginnt, eskaliert zum hitzigen Streit über Religion, Identität und Toleranz. Der Vorschlag, für das einzige türkische Mitglied einen eigenen Grill zu kaufen, lässt Atheisten, Gläubige, Deutsche und Türken frontal aufeinanderprallen - respektlos, pointiert und urkomisch. Schnell wird klar: Es geht um viel mehr als nur um einen Grill…

overview.de: Mit Evil Dead Burn beginnt ein neues Kapitel dämonischen Chaos bei einem Familientreffen.
overview.en: After her husband's death, a woman seeks solace with her in-laws. As one by one they are transformed into Deadites -- turning the gathering into a family reunion from hell -- she discovers the vows she took in life live on...even in death.

title.de: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
title.en: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald

title.de: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
title.en: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass

overview.de: Die Welt der Kleinstadtfriseurin Gail Daughtry bricht zusammen, als ihr Verlobter sie mit seinem „Promi-Pass" betrügt. Verletzt reist Gail mit ihrem besten Freund Otto spontan nach Los Angeles, um ihre Hochzeit zu retten und sich mit ihrem eigenen „Promi-Pass" - Jon Hamm - zu revanchieren. Auf der Jagd nach Hamm geraten sie in Konfrontationen mit Prominenten und Auftragskillern.
overview.en: When her fiancée beds his "celebrity pass," Gail sets out to even the scales with her own: Jon Hamm.

title.de: ドラゴンボール超 ビルス

overview.en:
After 18 years, we have the newest Dragon Ball story from creator Akira Toriyama.
With Majin Buu defeated, Goku has taken a completely new role as...a radish farmer?! With Earth at peace, our heroes have settled into normal lives. But they can’t get too comfortable. Far away, the powerful God of Destruction, Beerus, awakens to a prophecy revealing his demise at the hands of an even more formidable being. When his search for the Saiyan God brings him to Earth, can Goku and his friends take on their strongest foe yet?

overview.en: Welcome to the world of Minecraft, where creativity doesn’t just help you craft, it’s essential to one’s survival! Four misfits find themselves pulled through a mysterious portal into the Overworld: a cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they’ll have to master this world while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected expert crafter, Steve. Together, their adventure will challenge all five to be bold and to reconnect with the qualities that make each of them uniquely creative ... the very skills they need to thrive back in the real world.
